synopsis: The glossary identifies CEN/CENELEC JTC 21 as CEN and CENELEC’s joint artificial-intelligence committee [f15022]. Chapter 3 reports that JTC 21 was not verified in the review of machine-learning safety rules, alongside several other standards and the Korean AI Basic Act [f2392]. Two glossary entries repeat its not-verified status, so the supplied facts establish a review gap rather than a verified conclusion about the committee’s requirements or their applicability [f15022, f15302, f2392].

relations.note: Both report JTC 21 as not verified; Chapter 3 specifies the review context.
Both list JTC 21 and UL 4600 as not verified.
Both glossary entries repeat JTC 21’s not-verified status.
